payload.title: Restore editor Reference selection and truthful review feedback
payload.description: As an editor, I can select pending References, inspect actual publication and Section prediction state, approve or reject with optional explanation, and revise persisted feedback through authorized existing APIs. Scope: editor UI and required API integration; no email intake (PPY-65026c), training, production labels, merge or deployment. Reuse existing curation/relevance work. Acceptance: executable Gherkin plus fixture unit/integration/browser coverage of selection, prediction absence/error, optional explanation, persistence, authorization, failure recovery and repeated-click protection.
